description: This file declares the interface for fetching the status of a single instance within the 'cuttlefish' project. It includes a function that waits for the 'run_cvd' process to respond within a specified timeout, and references related classes and utilities.

classes.name: LocalInstance
classes.description: Represents a local instance whose status can be fetched.

methods.name: FetchInstanceStatus
methods.description: Fetches the status from a single instance, waits for the run_cvd process to respond within the specified timeout.
